subject: Change request for the intake form field labels
description: Two field labels on the intake form no longer match the words the delivery team uses day to day. Please update the labels and the help text underneath them.

subject: New project request for a joint reporting pilot
description: We would like to run a joint reporting pilot with your delivery team so both sides read the same weekly view instead of reconciling two of them.

subject: Access to the approvals administration console

subject: Access request for the shared document workspace
description: Two people joined our side of the project this week and cannot open the shared document workspace. Our work on the current milestone is on hold until they can.

subject: Change request for the escalation routing rules
description: Escalations raised outside working hours land in a queue nobody watches overnight. The routing rules need to send them to the on call rota instead.

subject: Weekly capacity report for the delivery leads
description: The delivery leads would like a weekly capacity view they can read themselves, rather than asking the operations team to export it each time.

subject: Report request for the quarterly delivery summary
description: Please send the quarterly delivery summary for our account in the same format as last quarter, with the open items listed at the end.
